messages.subject: IPM workshop -- Patuxent -- Nov 2017
parts:
Dear all,

we would welcome a couple more delegates for our workshop on Integrated Population Models (IPM) using BUGS software in Patuxent (30 Oct - 3 Nov 2017). Hence, we have extended the deadline for applications until 30 June; please see attached (revised) advertisement and also (the old advertisement) here: http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=3378&sid=2e4adb7230719b925d6da05ebd2a5936.

IPMs represent an incredibly powerful framework for using all available data sets on the demography of a population in one single, integrated population model. For virtually all ecologists, BUGS software is currently probably the only way how they can ever learn how to fit IPMs without enrolling the help of a PhD statistician.

Please spread to your friends and colleagues; thanks.

Best regards  ---- Marc




PS: We also still accept applications for the Fairbanks edition of this workshop, which takes place in the week immediately before; see here: http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=3379&sid=2e4adb7230719b925d6da05ebd2a5936
